Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Deployed hotfix v2.3.2** to checkout-api across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). This replaced v2.3.1, which was running unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
2. **Opened a SEV3 incident** (INC-0001) recording the change, which also paged the on-call engineer.

Please note the incident did page on-call — let me know if you'd like me to resolve/close it or if any follow-up is needed.
